message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine crimes. Facts: operating a gambling venue (mahjong) for profit. In Chinese law, that's "开设赌场罪" (Operating a casino). The offense is "开设赌场罪". Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But typical is "开设赌场罪" (establishing a casino). The profit is 600 yuan, small amount, but still crime. Also participants were arrested, but the defendant is the operator. So charge: 开设赌场. Also maybe "赌博罪"? Actually participants commit gambling, but operator is charged with "开设赌场罪". Also "非法占有" no. So single crime.

We must output without the character “罪”. So just "开设赌场". Format: [罪名]开设赌场<eoa>. JSON with final_answer containing that string.

Thus answer.
